purpose: Pinned gen7 HFI allocation-branch evidence. No hardware, HVC, MMIO mapping, allocation or GPU readiness is established by this file.

verification.method: Fetched immutable raw URL bytes; computed canonical raw SHA-256/Git blob SHA-1 and matched each blob against the complete pinned module Git tree. Local cache equality was checked only after CRLF-to-LF normalization; canonical hashes below never hash normalized cache bytes.

evidence.supports: GFX privilege/read-only/secure flags are independent inputs.
Without GFX_ACC, only kind19 uses a named fixed resource; other kinds allocate a GMU kernel SYSRAM block.
Kinds22 and23 use preallocated descriptors on this path; other GFX-accessible kinds allocate global SYSRAM and import to GMU only when GMU_ACC is present.
Successful replies publish the actual descriptor addresses and host handle without replacing request flags or logical size.
GMU kernel block allocates owned SYSMEM and maps with hard-coded READ|WRITE|PRIV regardless of the request GMU_ACC/PRIV/WRITE bits.
Fixed-resource helper takes an explicit resource name; kind19 passes qcom,ipc-core.
The ordinary global allocation path forces GLOBAL|SYSMEM and allocates kernel backing; secure flags use a separate secure allocator.
Kind11/12/13/20 enum names are DPU/TCSR/QDSS STM/IPCC AOSS; these names alone do not select a fixed resource in gen7 get_mem_alloc_entry.
Wire bits distinguish GFX/GMU ACC/PRIV/WRITE, GMU VA cache region, host access/init and secure GFX ownership.

implementation_contract.gmu_only_effective_flags: For ordinary SYSRAM with GFX_ACC clear, effective_flags=request_flags|0x38; preserve all original flags in the HFI reply and cache signature, and return actual GMU VA even when original GMU_ACC is clear.
implementation_contract.gfx_effective_flags: For ordinary SYSRAM with GFX_ACC set, effective_flags=request_flags; return GMU VA only when GMU_ACC is set.
implementation_contract.reserved_limit: Local secure kind5, GMU-only fixed kind19, GFX memstore kind22 and fence kind23 backends remain explicit; unsupported variants are not silently generalized.
implementation_contract.mapping_limit: This change selects the existing owned RAM/debug mapping backend. It creates no DPU/TCSR/QDSS/AOSS physical mapping and proves no running firmware/source equivalence or completion.
